target_customer: Engineering teams that want lower cloud bills and control, including GitHub Actions heavy teams and Postgres users
problem: Public cloud costs and lock-in are high. Ubicloud provides an open source cloud that runs on cheap bare metal providers, claiming 3 to 10 times lower cost.
business_model: Usage-based managed cloud services (compute, Postgres, GitHub Actions runners) plus open source self-hosting

founders.name: Umur Cubukcu
prior_employers: Y Combinator (visiting partner W23 and S23)
previous_startups: Citus Data (YC S11, acquired by Microsoft 2019)

founders.name: Ozgun Erdogan
previous_startups: Citus Data (co-founder and CTO, acquired by Microsoft 2019)

competitors.name: OpenStack
competitors.what: Long-standing open source cloud operating system
competitors.traction_then: Established but complex to operate, per TechCrunch framing

technical_complexity.rationale: Building virtualization, networking, block storage, managed Postgres and IAM on bare metal with a team of about 10 is a big systems engineering challenge, but the founders had deep Postgres and cloud experience.

defensibility.rationale: Open source code lets anyone copy it, but operating a reliable cloud on bare metal and database expertise take time, and migrations create switching costs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AWS and others did not copy the approach per sources. In January 2026 ClickHouse announced a native Postgres service built with Ubicloud, showing partnership rather than competition.

market_need_then: Cloud bills were a widely discussed pain point in 2023 to 2024, with cost repatriation and bare metal growth, and GitHub Actions runner cost was a clear acute spend.

identity.visual_style: Developer infrastructure style with compliance badges
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct, short punchy taglines on cost and freedom from lock-in, positioned against incumbent clouds

branding.brand_signature: Positioning as the open source AWS
branding.community_and_virality: Open source community on GitHub; a forum commenter said the name made them think of Ubisoft; the open source startup podcast featured the founders

brand_strength.rationale: Clear, well-understood positioning as the open source AWS with solid TechCrunch and SiliconANGLE coverage, but the name evokes Ubisoft for some and no mascot or community ritual.

outcome_analysis: Ubicloud raised a 16 million dollar seed on the strength of founders with a prior YC exit, then shipped compute, Postgres and cheap GitHub Actions runners and gained named customers like Felt and Hatchet. A 2026 ClickHouse partnership and a 26 percent price rise suggest traction and cost pressure; some outages were recorded. No later round is reported.
notes: Seed 16M announced 2024-03-05 and closed in early January 2024 per TechCrunch; also on the company site. CB Insights lists 16.5M total including a 0.5M convertible note on 2024-01-01 (aggregator, unverified). VCBacked also lists Pioneer Fund, Liquid 2 and ScaleX (aggregator). Education not found. Pricing and ClickHouse items are from search snippets.
